about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Be with us, we beseech You, O merciful God, and by the intercession of blessed Joseph, Your Confessor, graciously keep safe the gifts You have given us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
